full_inspection: All four supplied halves were read and compared line by line, including the title, author, all ten contents entries, underlines, Q glyphs, complete N.B., handwritten calls, every margin group and both archive foliations. The separate point loci are recorded without inferring their physical origin.
original_transcription_comparison: Compared both original full transcriptions with each other and with the checked copy1 file. Their added marginal groups, changed foliation, different quotation encoding and omitted copy2 point after7 were all inspected; both original files also missed the handwritten N.B. calls. The review adds the previously unrecorded copy2 point after enfant. with uncertainty.

entries.decision: retain the copy1 uncertainty and the absence of a point in copy2
entries.reason: A small baseline point is present only in copy1. Its origin as typewriting or incidental speck remains unresolved; this category records the body-reading difference without resolving that origin.

entries.decision: add the overlooked doubtful point in copy2
entries.reason: The side-by-side enlargement shows a smaller second black baseline point in copy2 and none in copy1. The original copy2 text omitted it; typed punctuation versus incidental mark remains uncertain.

entries.decision: use the same source-appropriate quotation encoding in copy2
entries.reason: The two images have matching straight double-quote strokes. The original LaTeX differed only because copy2 used opening/closing quote ligatures.
